title: Function Userlookup
author: reprise99
description: Save as a function in your workspace then invoke via its name, i.e if you save as UserLookup UserLookup | where UserPrincipalName == "user1@domain.com" // will find information for user1@domain.com UserLookup | where Countries has "AU" and ['Authentication Methods'] has "Windows Hello for Business" // will find all users who have signed in from Australia and have used WHFB UserLookup | where JobTitle == "Chief Astronaut" and IPAddresses has "10.10.10.10" // will find all Chief Astronauts who have signed on from 10.10.10.10 This will parse the last 14 days of the IdentityInfo, SigninLogs and SecurityAlerts tables for information
